about.title: A small software company with big-company standards.
about.intro: Elmasry Tech is a Cairo-based software development company founded by two engineers. We build websites, mobile apps and business systems for companies in Egypt and the Gulf — and we stay on after launch.
about.story_p1: Too many businesses we met were running on spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups and software that didn’t fit how they work. Off-the-shelf tools forced them to change; agencies delivered something pretty that no one maintained.
about.story_p2: We started Elmasry Tech to do the opposite: understand the operation first, then build software that fits it — fast, bilingual, secure, and owned by the client.
about.value_1: Clarity over jargon — you always know what is being built and why.
about.value_2: Ship small, ship often — weekly demos instead of big reveals.
about.value_3: Measure success by your business results, not by lines of code.
